name: Abyss Born
detailed_description:
Your camp lies in ruins. Your companions are dead, and the only survivor—your closest friend—has been taken by monsters. Barely escaping with your life, you embark on a perilous journey to find your lost friend and uncover the truth behind the dark forces that ravaged your world.

Will you survive in a land overrun by skeletal hordes, goblin raiders, and ancient undead? Can you build your own shelter, forge alliances, and seal the portals that spew forth endless horrors?

KEY FEATURES 

🏚 Build and expand your shelter – Gather resources, fortify your base, and prepare for the dangers ahead.
⚔ Explore dark dungeons – Venture into caves, ruins, catacombs, and ancient tombs filled with treasures—and nightmares.
🛠 Craft weapons and armor – Forge and upgrade powerful gear to take on increasingly deadly enemies.
🌿 Alchemy and gathering – Collect herbs and mushrooms to brew powerful potions, elixirs, and deadly poisons.
🏰 Allies and trade – Earn the trust of dwarves and the human kingdom to gain access to valuable resources and support.
🦴 Hordes of enemies – Face relentless goblins, skeleton warriors, and terrifying undead monstrosities.
🕳 Seal the dark portals – Discover the source of the invasion and stop the spread of darkness before it’s too late.

This is more than just a battle for survival—it’s a fight for the fate of the world. Will you dare to face the abyss? 🌑

short_description: Abyss Born is a single-player dark action RPG with survival and dungeon crawler elements. Fight various monsters, explore dangerous dungeons, trade with allies and complete quests to find a friend and face evil.
